stories.title: Lindsay Clancy jury fails to reach a consensus on sixth day of deliberations
stories.summary: There was drama in the courtroom Thursday in the trial of the Massachusetts mother charged with murdering her three children. The jury has been trying to reach consensus for six days.

stories.title: Gloria Steinem helped shape the classic children's album 'Free to Be... You and Me'
stories.summary: Through Ms. Magazine, the late activist and author Gloria Steinem was one of the driving forces behind one of the most classic children's albums, Free to Be... You and Me from 1972.

stories.title: Nepali community in Texas grieves and prays for healing after flash floods
stories.summary: Nepalese groups in North Texas, which has one of the largest communities of people from Nepal in the U.S., continue to grieve the loss of hundreds of people after the devastating floods in August.

stories.title: Swing voters say Trump hasn't delivered on his promise to lower prices
stories.summary: As the midterms near, NPR's Tamara Keith has another installment of her Swing Shift project. Three swing voters in Pennsylvania tell us what affordability means to them.

stories.title: As El Niño intensifies, Rio turns to science — and a spiritual advisor
stories.summary: This year's Super El Niño has brought unprecedented weather to Rio de Janeiro. Unaccustomed to tornado-strength winds, the city found an unusual partner to combat the weather: a spiritual adviser.

stories.title: Immigration policies prompt differing messages from Republicans and Democrats
stories.summary: Republicans see immigration as a winning issue ahead of the midterms as President Trump's administration ramps up arrests and deportations.
